label: Bible Study
prompt: For as he _____ in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verse: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
note: Often quoted about mindset — in context, it's a warning about a stingy host's fake hospitality.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be _____.
verse: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
note: Zechariah's surprise ending: at evening time, just when it should get dark, it shall be light.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the _____ of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
verse: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
note: Even after his death, Elisha's bones brought a man back to life — a miracle-worker to the very end.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Elias was a man subject to like _____ as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verse: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
note: Elias (Elijah) was made of the same clay as us, James insists — yet his prayer shut the sky for three and a half years.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and _____ of heart,
verse: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
note: The first church: daily together, breaking bread house to house, with 'gladness and singleness of heart.'
